public.title: Schema Validator
public.description: input {schema,value}; schema has primitive type string, boolean or integer, or object with fields mapping names to primitive schemas. Return invalid paths in declared-field order ($ for root, $.name for fields). Missing declared fields fail, extra fields are ignored, null is never a valid primitive. No coercion or optional fields. A wrong object root emits only $. This descriptor adapter covers primitive schemas and flat shapes. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.
